summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new single-thread email routing model (distributor To + brand company & dealer CC, distributor de-duplicated OUT of CC). Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passed (added 7 new tests under TestDistributorRouting covering distributor set/get, brand routing with catch_all + installation, ticket To/CC/collaborators structure verification, public reply 200, internal reply 200, cleanup). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: dealer-email-input required + submits successfully to VOLT-000002; admin login; Settings distributor-email-input present, editable, saved; TicketDetail 'Recipients (one thread)' panel shows To=distributor and CC list excluding distributor with the dealer email; public reply appends and posts 200; internal reply appends. Role gating (agent forbidden from PUT /api/settings) still returns 403.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown — migrate to lifespan.

send_via_emergent merges CC into single recipients list because the managed proxy has no cc field; this yields ONE email but recipients see all addresses in To (not proper CC semantics). Only send_via_resend maintains true To/CC. Consider documenting or noting this limitation in the UI/Settings.

create_ticket() ticket.email_status is set to 'sent' only when dispatch_email returns a non-empty id; the Resend path returns id from JSON — good. Emergent path returns None when EMAIL_KEY unset -> 'skipped'.

resolve_collaborators falls back to default_stakeholders only when the brand has no catch_all AND no per-type routing; this is fine but caller code then removes distributor and appends dealer separately — could extract helper for clarity.
No unique index on db.counters.id (used by next_ticket_number); atomic upsert makes it safe but adding index would be belt-and-suspenders.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — invalid per spec; ensure CORS_ORIGINS env is explicit in prod.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed tickets across VOLT/LG/TDxxxx during pytest and one UI-driven VOLT-000002 with dealer uidealer@example.com. Distributor setting reverted to admin default at end of test class. Transient TDxxxx brand and agent user were deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 30 tests including TestDistributorRouting which verifies To=[distributor], CC contains catch_all + per-type routing + dealer_email, distributor never in CC, collaborators=to+cc, and both public/internal replies return 200. TicketDetail 'Recipients (one thread)' panel uses data-testid=collaborators-list. Public form has required dealer-email-input. Note: email_status may legitimately be 'failed' when Resend is provider and recipients are on example.com/.org — verify structure not delivery.
